flags.title: ✅ Daglig uppdatering lagad 10 aug

flags.title: Order counts now exclude cancelled orders, and days are cut in Swedish time
flags.body: Two corrections to how these figures are built. Cancelled orders are no longer counted as sales: Shopify's own revenue figure includes them, which is why a number here can read lower than the one in the Shopify app. And each day is now cut at Swedish midnight in our own code, because Shopify's date filter was returning two days' orders as one.
flags.sub: Checked against 23 Aug: 8 real orders and €608, plus one cancelled order. Shopify shows €756 for the same day because it counts the cancelled one.
